question: What is the direction of camera movement when shooting this video?
options: A. left, which means the camera angle swings left (pan left), or the camera moves left (track left).
B. right, which means the camera angle swings right (pan right), or the camera moves right (track right).
C. up, which means the camera angle swings up (tilt up), or the camera moves up (boom up).
D. down, which means the camera angle swings down (tilt down), or the camera moves down (boom down).
E. in, which means camera pushes toward the subject (dolly in), or enlarges the frame (zoom in)
F. out, which means camera moves away the subject (dolly out), or expands the visible area, makeing the subject appear smaller (zoom out).
G. fixed, which means camera is almost fixed and does not change.

B. right, which means the camera angle swings right (pan right), or the camera moves right (track right).
C. up, which means the camera angle swings up (tilt up), or the camera moves up (boom up).
D. down, which means the camera angle swings down (tilt down), or the camera moves down (boom down).
E. in, which means camera pushes toward the subject (dolly in), or enlarges the frame (zoom in)
F. out, which means camera moves away the subject (dolly out), or expands the visible area, makeing the subject appear smaller (zoom out).
G. fixed, which means camera is almost fixed and does not change.

B. right, which means the camera angle swings right (pan right), or the camera moves right (track right).
C. up, which means the camera angle swings up (tilt up), or the camera moves up (boom up).
D. down, which means the camera angle swings down (tilt down), or the camera moves down (boom down).
E. in, which means camera pushes toward the subject (dolly in), or enlarges the frame (zoom in)
F. out, which means camera moves away the subject (dolly out), or expands the visible area, makeing the subject appear smaller (zoom out).
G. fixed, which means camera is almost fixed and does not change.

B. right, which means the camera angle swings right (pan right), or the camera moves right (track right).
C. up, which means the camera angle swings up (tilt up), or the camera moves up (boom up).
D. down, which means the camera angle swings down (tilt down), or the camera moves down (boom down).
E. in, which means camera pushes toward the subject (dolly in), or enlarges the frame (zoom in)
F. out, which means camera moves away the subject (dolly out), or expands the visible area, makeing the subject appear smaller (zoom out).
G. fixed, which means camera is almost fixed and does not change.
